⚓️🛥 YACHT PARTY — prepare to set sail for Seattle’s most decadent nightlife experience.

Hidden inside Belltown Yacht Club, Belltown’s best kept secret speakeasy cabaret, we’re dropping anchor for a night of drag, burlesque, craft cocktails, and an underground dance party that will keep the ship rocking until late.

Your captain for the evening, Brandi Marxxx, guides us through a glittering voyage of entertainment while the dance floor cruises through Top 40 hits, Yacht Rock classics, and iconic 80’s anthems to keep every sailor grooving.

✨ Dress in your best yacht attire
🍸 Craft cocktails flowing
💃 Drag & burlesque performances
🪩 Dance party until 2AM

🗓️ 4/10
⛵ Doors 9:30PM | Show 10:30PM

This queer-led Seattle nightlife event is sponsored by Lush Bar and produced by Haus of Sutra.

🎟 Tickets available now:
hausofsutra.com presale ticket = FREE welcome shot!

Grab your crew, step aboard, and let’s make waves in Belltown. 🌊

posts.caption:
Beloveds, it’s time.

After a sold-out winter show, Drag Church is returning to the sanctuary for a night of release and rebuilding with REBIRTH.

Tickets are LIVE at bit.ly/dragchurch-rebirth

Grab yours before they’re gone.

REBIRTH is a full-scale revival that blends queer art, activism, and radical joy and reminds us that...
Transformation doesn’t always arrive gently.
Sometimes it feels like unraveling.
Like the necessary crumbling of what can no longer hold us.

This event is rooted in the belief that new beginnings require release. Release of old stories, structures, and ways of being that no longer serve us. Through electrifying drag performances, a guided meditation, and intentional communal participation, we explore the truth that breaking is not failure. The truth that some things must break before a better foundation can be built.

A curated lineup of unforgettable artists @bjblessings @thebrandi_marx @kara.sutra @jizzuhbelljohnson will deliver performances that guide the evening through moments of rejoice, rejuvenescence, and release.

REBIRTH invites you to envision something brand new and nurture the seeds of liberation, build deeper community connections, and co-create the world we wish existed.

This spiritually inclusive, family-friendly gathering also features a fundraiser supporting Lambert House and The Little Wildflowers Co-Op Preschool and investing directly in LGBTQ+ youth in our region.

Event Details
🗓️ April 4, 2026
⏰ Doors 6:30 PM | Show 7:30 PM
📍 7400 Woodlawn Ave NE, Seattle

🎟️ Tickets bit.ly/dragchurch-rebirth
$25 General Admission (first come/first seated)
$50 VIP (Front 2 rows of traditional church pews, a gift, & signed poster by the cast)
Limited Pay-What-You-Can tickets available

Production @yassifyjesus @hausofsutra 
Lights and Sound @litheon 
Photography and Videography @whereisjessenow

#seattleevents #seattledrag #dragchurch #queerart

posts.caption:
When Kitty Smith @kitty.zero.hour @yassifyjesus, an artist disgruntled with Trump’s reelection, began to draw dragified versions of Jesus in 2024 to protest the increasing negativity toward LGBTQIA+ people across the country, never did she expect her idea to “yassify Jesus” would transform into a full-blown, flamboyant church service. 

Working with Kara Sutra @kara.sutra (the drag mother of the @hausofsutra), she had decided a year ago to create a nonreligious, all-ages space for LGBTQIA+ people to build community together, called Drag Church. Now as they move toward their first anniversary, the duo plan to up the ante of extravagance and community engagement with the upcoming service, aptly named “REBIRTH.” 

Read the full article online at www.sgn.org, or in our April 2026 issue out now!

Photo credit: Jesse Sieden
